about

I'm Anand, a data scientist who got curious about what makes AI systems trustworthy enough to act on.

Most of my work sits at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning, and generative AI: multi-agent LLM councils for enterprise decision support, clinical and agricultural computer vision, and RAG-driven assistants.
